slides.text: AI Life Coach Companion | Empowering Modern Lifestyles Through AI Guidance | By: [Your Name] & [Partner’s Name] | Web, iOS & Android App Proposal

Vision | An AI-driven personal lifestyle companion for ages 25–50. | Acts as a virtual mentor offering personalized guidance in: | - Fitness & Exercise | - Fashion & Grooming | - Skin & Hair Care | - Etiquette & Professional Behavior | - Travel Planning & Lifestyle Curation | Accessible via Web, iOS, and Android.

The Problem | • Lifestyle advice is fragmented and overwhelming. | • No personalized, trusted guidance adapted to one’s age and goals. | • Professionals seek accessible, affordable coaching for wellness and personal development.

The Solution | Introducing an AI-powered Life Coach Avatar — your 24/7 mentor. | • Personalized for 25–30, 30–40, 40–50. | • Delivers tailored guidance and motivation. | • Combines human empathy with AI intelligence.

Key Features | • AI Character (Coach Ava) — relatable and realistic | • Personalized Coaching Plans | • Weekly Videos, Lookbooks, Etiquette Tips | • Interactive Q&A Chat | • Travel Planner Module | • Blog & Premium Content Library

Target Market | • Demographics: 25–50-year-old professionals | • Regions: North America, Europe, South Asia | • Market Size: $10B+ wellness and lifestyle industry | • Trends: Personalization, digital coaching, AI adoption

Technology & Design Plan | • Phase 1: Web app (React + Flask/Django backend) | • Phase 2: iOS (Swift), Android (Kotlin) | • AI Integration: GPT-based conversational model + video avatar | • Hosting: AWS or Google Cloud | • Domain: ai-life-coach.com (example) | • Design: Figma → UI/UX → Launch

Revenue Model | • Subscription Plans: |    - Free: Limited access |    - Premium ($9.99/mo): Full AI & video content |    - Elite ($29.99/mo): 1:1 personalization | • Affiliate partnerships: Fashion, fitness, skincare, travel | • Ads, sponsorships, and upsells
Marketing Strategy | • Phase 1: Social media launch (Instagram, YouTube, TikTok) | • Phase 2: Influencer collaborations | • Phase 3: Brand partnerships and SEO | • Referral program for user growth

Financials & Funding | • Domain & Hosting: $200 | • MVP Development: $15K–25K | • AI Licensing: $3K–5K | • Marketing Launch: $10K–20K | • Projected Revenue: |    - Year 1: $50K–75K |    - Year 2: $250K+ with 10K paid subscribers
Roadmap | • Month 1: Branding & Prototype | • Month 2–3: Web MVP | • Month 4–6: App Build | • Month 6: Marketing Launch | • Month 7+: Partnerships & Monetization
The Team | • You: Product Vision & Strategy | • Partner: Creative & Marketing | • Tech Lead: Development & AI Integration | • Advisors: Lifestyle & Fitness Experts

Call to Action | Let’s co-create the next generation of lifestyle AI. | Seeking: | • Partnership Alignment | • Seed Funding | • Development & Marketing Support | “Empower lifestyles with AI intelligence and human warmth.”

Web & Mobile App Mock UI Concepts | The app interface is designed for simplicity and engagement: | • **Homepage:** Personalized greeting from the AI coach with quick links to Fitness, Fashion, Travel, and Care sections. | • **Coach Chat:** Conversational window where users can talk to their AI mentor, ask questions, and receive tips. | • **Weekly Plan Dashboard:** Displays exercise schedules, outfit suggestions, and wellness tasks. | • **Media Hub:** Access to weekly videos, blog posts, and photo galleries. | • **Mobile Layout:** Consistent with web app — optimized for quick navigation and daily engagement.
